o.text: Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish مكتوب (mäktūb), borrowed from Arabic مَكْتُوب (maktūb).
From Proto-Turkic *karga (“crow”). See Bashkir ҡарға (qarğa) for more cognates.
Borrowed from Persian زحمتکش (zahmatkeš), equivalent to zəhmət (“labour; effort; suffering; troubles”) + -keş.
Borrowed from Arabic سِيَاسِيّ (siyāsiyy). By surface analysis, siyasət + -i.
From Persian جفت Doublet of cüt.
